lines.zh: 我绕训练场走一圈，看每个人的脚。
lines.en: I circle the yard, watching everyone's feet.

lines.zh: 我走得很正，肩不晃。
lines.en: I walk straight, shoulders still.

lines.zh: 我踩着木桩的间距走，量过的。
lines.en: I pace the stake spacing. I measured it.

lines.zh: 靴跟磕地，三下一停。
lines.en: My heels strike: three beats, then a pause.

lines.zh: 我走过谁身后，谁就站直了。
lines.en: Whoever I pass straightens up.

lines.zh: 我绕着靶子走，看箭孔偏哪边。
lines.en: I round the targets, reading where bolts drifted.

lines.zh: 我的步子慢，因为我不用赶。
lines.en: I walk slowly. I have no need to hurry.

lines.zh: 我沿着栅栏走，检查每一根。
lines.en: I walk the fence, testing every post.

lines.zh: 腰间挂着教鞭，不是武器。
lines.en: A training cane at my belt, not a weapon.

lines.zh: 我走在队伍最前面，从不回头。
lines.en: I lead the line and never look back.

lines.zh: 我走时数着学员的呼吸。
lines.en: As I walk, I count the students' breathing.

lines.zh: 走到场中央，我就停下来说话。
lines.en: At the yard's center I stop and speak.

lines.zh: 我抱着手臂，看你们练。
lines.en: Arms folded, I watch you drill.

lines.zh: 我把教鞭在掌心敲了两下。
lines.en: I tap the cane twice against my palm.

lines.zh: 我站在阴影里，不说话最有用。
lines.en: I stand in shade; silence teaches best.

lines.zh: 我在等有人出错，好开口。
lines.en: I wait for a mistake so I may speak.

lines.zh: 靶上还插着昨天的箭。
lines.en: Yesterday's bolts still stand in the targets.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看了看太阳的位置。
lines.en: I glance up at where the sun stands.

lines.zh: 喉咙有点干，我不去喝水。
lines.en: My throat is dry. I do not go drink.

lines.zh: 我整理袖口，一次比一次紧。
lines.en: I straighten my cuffs, tighter each time.

lines.zh: 我在心里排今天的课。
lines.en: I lay out today's lesson in my head.

lines.zh: 有人偷懒，我看见了。
lines.en: Someone is idling. I saw.

lines.zh: 站直，我不用第二遍。
lines.en: Stand up straight. I will not repeat it.

lines.zh: 你的手，放低两寸。
lines.en: Your hands. Two inches lower.

lines.zh: 盯着你的脚尖，那才是破绽。
lines.en: I watch your toes; that is where you fail.

lines.zh: 你紧张什么？我又不吃人。
lines.en: Nervous? I do not eat people.

lines.zh: 你眼睛飘了，说明你心虚。
lines.en: Your eyes wander. That means doubt.

lines.zh: 我这么看你，是在找你怕什么。
lines.en: I look at you to find what you fear.

lines.zh: 你的准头不行，眼神倒是好。
lines.en: Your aim is poor; your eyes are good.

lines.zh: 别躲我的目光，躲的人先输。
lines.en: Do not dodge my gaze. The one who looks away loses.

lines.zh: 你身上有伤？说，怎么弄的。
lines.en: You are hurt? Tell me how.

lines.zh: 我看你是在想：这老头行不行。
lines.en: You are thinking: can this old man teach?

lines.zh: 我挨这一下，是让你看清破绽。
lines.en: I take this blow so you see the opening.

lines.zh: 手麻了，正好换左手。
lines.en: My hand is numb. Good; I switch to the left.

lines.zh: 我退半步，脚没乱。
lines.en: I give half a step, feet still ordered.

lines.zh: 破皮而已，别大惊小怪。
lines.en: Just broken skin. Do not fuss.

lines.zh: 打得不重，力道从腰起。
lines.en: Not heavy. Power starts from the waist.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙笑了一下。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and smile.

lines.zh: 这一下说明你急了。
lines.en: That strike shows you are rushed.

lines.zh: 我按住肋下，慢慢直起腰。
lines.en: I press my side and straighten slowly.

lines.zh: 老骨头，响一声是正常的。
lines.en: Old bones. A crack is normal.

lines.zh: 别停，趁着我还站着。
lines.en: Do not stop while I am still standing.

lines.zh: 拿钱来学？那你学不会。
lines.en: Paying to learn? Then you will not learn.

lines.zh: 酒放下，练完再喝。
lines.en: Put the drink down. You drink after drills.

lines.zh: 我不收礼物，只收汗水。
lines.en: I take no gifts, only sweat.

lines.zh: 你想用一顿饭换一课？
lines.en: A meal for a lesson? Is that the trade?

lines.zh: 那副好弩给我看，不是给我。
lines.en: Show me that fine crossbow. Not for me.

lines.zh: 别拿吃的糊弄我，我闻得出敷衍。
lines.en: Do not bribe me with food. I smell laziness.

lines.zh: 你的谢礼，留给下一个教你的人。
lines.en: Save your thanks for whoever teaches you next.

lines.zh: 我不缺东西，我缺能站住的人。
lines.en: I lack nothing but people who can hold their ground.

lines.zh: 递烟过来也没用，我不抽。
lines.en: Offering a pipe is useless. I do not smoke.

lines.zh: 收起来，训练场上不兴这套。
lines.en: Put it away. We do not do that here.

lines.zh: 站稳，撞一下就歪，怎么打？
lines.en: Stand firm. One bump and you tilt — how will you fight?

lines.zh: 撞我是练步法，不是撒气。
lines.en: Bumping me trains footwork, not temper.

lines.zh: 我脚跟没挪，你自己退开了。
lines.en: My heels have not shifted; you stepped away.

lines.zh: 侧身，别用胸口接。
lines.en: Turn your side. Do not take it on the chest.

lines.zh: 你踩我脚了，重心太前。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot. Your weight is too far forward.

lines.zh: 我抬手一挡，你就偏出去了。
lines.en: I raise an arm and you slide off.

lines.zh: 挤过来没用，我站得比石头稳。
lines.en: Shoving is useless. I stand steadier than stone.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，留出一臂。
lines.en: Not so close. Keep an arm's length.

lines.zh: 撞完记住：脚比手先动。
lines.en: Remember: the feet move before the hands.

lines.zh: 再来一次，这次别闭眼。
lines.en: Again. This time do not shut your eyes.

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，只教人，不娶人。
lines.en: At my age I teach, I do not wed.

lines.zh: 训练场就是我的家，学员就是我的事。
lines.en: The yard is my home; students are my business.

lines.zh: 别打听这些，去练你的桩。
lines.en: Do not pry. Go practice your stakes.

lines.zh: 我年轻时的伴儿，也死在这些东西手里。
lines.en: My partner died to these things too, long ago.

lines.zh: 我一个人睡得踏实。
lines.en: I sleep soundly alone.

lines.zh: 这门手艺不靠血脉传，靠肯学的人。
lines.en: This craft passes by effort, not by blood.

lines.zh: 你问错人了，问教官不如问靶子。
lines.en: Wrong person. Ask the targets, not me.

lines.zh: 我手上的老茧，比婚戒值钱。
lines.en: The callus on my hand is worth more than a ring.

lines.zh: 成家会软，软了就打不动了。
lines.en: A family softens you, and soft hands cannot strike.

lines.zh: 我早把这事放在门外了。
lines.en: I left that matter outside the gate.

lines.zh: 地上的箭我捡，能修就修。
lines.en: I gather spent bolts and mend what I can.

lines.zh: 那根木桩歪了，我抽出来重削。
lines.en: That stake is crooked; I pull it and recut it.

lines.zh: 学员掉的护腕，我放在台子上。
lines.en: A dropped bracer goes on the bench.

lines.zh: 我捡起断弦，绕成一圈。
lines.en: I pick up a snapped string and coil it.

lines.zh: 谁的水袋？自己来拿。
lines.en: Whose waterskin? Come get it yourself.

lines.zh: 我把靶上拔下的箭按长短分好。
lines.en: I sort pulled bolts by length.

lines.zh: 布条留着，包扎用得上。
lines.en: Keep the cloth strips for bandages.

lines.zh: 掉的东西先放筐里，练完再领。
lines.en: Dropped gear goes in the basket. Claim it after drills.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起一枚马蹄铁。
lines.en: I bend and pick up a horseshoe.

lines.zh: 东西不该在地上，捡起来。
lines.en: Gear does not belong on the ground. Pick it up.

lines.zh: 靶子立好了，谁先来？
lines.en: Targets are up. Who goes first?

lines.zh: 那个学员抬弩的姿势不对。
lines.en: That student's crossbow angle is wrong.

lines.zh: 我看见有人偷换轻箭。
lines.en: I see someone swapping in light bolts.

lines.zh: 门口来了个陌生人，我先看着。
lines.en: A stranger at the gate. I watch first.

lines.zh: 那匹马在门口停太久，不对劲。
lines.en: That horse lingers at the gate. Wrong.

lines.zh: 有人在墙外数我们的脚步。
lines.en: Someone outside the wall counts our steps.

lines.zh: 我盯上那个躲在树后的影子。
lines.en: I fix on the shape behind the tree.

lines.zh: 场上有个人心不在焉，我要点他。
lines.en: One student is elsewhere. I will call him out.

lines.zh: 那支箭飞歪了，我要找出原因。
lines.en: That bolt flew wide. I will find why.

lines.zh: 有血味，从北边的路来。
lines.en: Blood on the air, from the north road.

lines.zh: 学员里少了一个，我记得脸。
lines.en: One student is missing. I remember the face.

lines.zh: 我先看脚，脚会先说真话。
lines.en: I look at the feet first; feet tell truth first.

lines.zh: 目标是那个不喘气的家伙。
lines.en: My mark is the one who is not breathing.

lines.zh: 我把教鞭换到左手，右手空出来。
lines.en: I shift the cane to my left and free my right.

lines.zh: 那家伙从不眨眼，我盯上了。
lines.en: That one never blinks; he is mine.

lines.zh: 我站在他侧后，看他怎么转身。
lines.en: I stand at his back quarter and watch him turn.

lines.zh: 我不出声，让他自己发现。
lines.en: I stay silent and let him notice.

lines.zh: 他手在抖，我记下了。
lines.en: His hands tremble. Noted.

lines.zh: 我绕到靶子的另一边。
lines.en: I circle to the far side of the target.

lines.zh: 我等他第三箭，那时最松。
lines.en: I wait for his third bolt; that is when he slackens.

lines.zh: 我盯着他的呼吸，节奏乱了。
lines.en: I watch his breathing break rhythm.

lines.zh: 他退一尺，我进一尺，不留空。
lines.en: He gives a foot; I take a foot. No gap.

lines.zh: 我在数他换箭的次数。
lines.en: I count how often he reloads.

lines.zh: 他看我了，那就开始。
lines.en: He looked at me. Then we begin.

lines.zh: 我把重心放低，随时能出手。
lines.en: I lower my weight, ready to move.

lines.zh: 他身后的靶子还没倒，正合适。
lines.en: The target behind him still stands. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我不喊停，喊停学不到东西。
lines.en: I will not call halt; halting teaches nothing.

lines.zh: 他的脚跟离地了。
lines.en: His heel has left the ground.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就出手纠正。
lines.en: One more step and I correct him by hand.

lines.zh: 我数他退了几步，够了。
lines.en: I count his retreating steps; enough.

lines.zh: 我把教鞭垂下来，让他放松。
lines.en: I lower the switch so he relaxes.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸乱了，现在出手。
lines.en: His breathing breaks; now.

lines.zh: 我站在他的影子里，等他转身。
lines.en: I stand in his shadow, waiting for him to turn.

lines.zh: 他的脚步往后，我就往前。
lines.en: He steps back and I step in.

lines.zh: 我看着他抬手，慢了一拍。
lines.en: I watch him raise the hand, half a beat late.

lines.zh: 我抬手一格，你的力全偏了。
lines.en: I turn your blow aside; all your force is wasted.

lines.zh: 我打你手腕，不是打你脸。
lines.en: I strike your wrist, not your face.

lines.zh: 这一下是让你记住距离。
lines.en: This one is to teach you distance.

lines.zh: 我拿教鞭敲你膝弯，站直。
lines.en: The cane taps your knee: stand straight.

lines.zh: 我推你肩膀，你就知道重心在哪。
lines.en: I push your shoulder so you feel your weight.

lines.zh: 出拳要短，收要快。
lines.en: Punch short, recover fast.

lines.zh: 我一让，你的拳就打在空气里。
lines.en: I shift and your fist finds empty air.

lines.zh: 我按住你的弩，不许你乱射。
lines.en: I press your crossbow down. No wild shots.

lines.zh: 疼吗？疼才记得住。
lines.en: Does it hurt? Pain makes it stick.

lines.zh: 我打三下，你挡了一下。
lines.en: I strike three times; you block one.

lines.zh: 你的手抬太高，腋下全空。
lines.en: Your guard is high; your armpit is open.

lines.zh: 我收手了，你还在退。
lines.en: I have stopped, and you are still retreating.

lines.zh: 这一鞭是提醒，下一鞭不会轻。
lines.en: This cane is a warning. The next will not be gentle.

lines.zh: 起来，站着挨打也比躺着强。
lines.en: Get up. Taking hits standing beats lying down.

lines.zh: 我一脚扫他脚踝，让他明白。
lines.en: I sweep his ankle so he understands.

lines.zh: 我用鞭柄顶他胸口，退三步。
lines.en: My switch handle hits his chest; he steps back three.

lines.zh: 这一下不打脸，打的是姿势。
lines.en: I do not hit the face, I hit the stance.

lines.zh: 他挡了，但重心全丢了。
lines.en: He blocked, and lost his balance completely.

lines.zh: 训练场空着，我先把靶立起来。
lines.en: The yard is empty. I set the targets up first.

lines.zh: 上一批学员走了，靶上还有箭。
lines.en: The last class left; arrows still in the targets.

lines.zh: 我推开门，灰落了一肩。
lines.en: I push the door; dust settles on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 有人在这里教过，木桩还在。
lines.en: Someone taught here before. The stakes remain.

lines.zh: 我带来一箱弩机，先修再说。
lines.en: I bring a crate of mechanisms; repair first.

lines.zh: 天没亮我就到了，习惯。
lines.en: I arrived before dawn. Habit.

lines.zh: 我在墙上刻下第一批名字。
lines.en: I cut the first names into the wall.

lines.zh: 这地方够大，能站二十个人。
lines.en: This place is large enough for twenty.

lines.zh: 我把教鞭挂在门后，然后取下。
lines.en: I hang the cane behind the door, then take it down.

lines.zh: 有人把我请来，说缺个教官。
lines.en: Someone called me here, saying they lacked a trainer.

lines.zh: 我先走一圈，看看场地。
lines.en: I walk the ground first, judging the space.

lines.zh: 我的靴子换了新的，旧的在包里。
lines.en: New boots on; the old pair rides in my pack.

lines.zh: 门口的牌子歪了，我扶正。
lines.en: The gate sign leaned; I set it straight.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这里我说了算。
lines.en: From today, this yard answers to me.

lines.zh: 火舌舔到我的袖子，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Flame licks my sleeve; I slap it twice.

lines.zh: 我从台子上滑下来，摔在草上。
lines.en: I slip off the platform and land in the grass.

lines.zh: 水到胸口了，我把弩举过头顶。
lines.en: Water at my chest; I hold the crossbow overhead.

lines.zh: 耳朵嗡了，我喊了一声没人应。
lines.en: My ears ring; I shout and no one answers.

lines.zh: 箭插进我的肩甲，学员手真准。
lines.en: A bolt sticks in my pauldron. The student aims well.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的教鞭发烫。
lines.en: That light makes my cane hot to hold.

lines.zh: 早课没吃，我该吃点东西了。
lines.en: I skipped breakfast. I should eat.

lines.zh: 雷劈在场中央，靶子全焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the yard's center; targets char.

lines.zh: 我掉下去时还攥着教鞭。
lines.en: I fall still gripping the cane.
